text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo cowers at the sheer crowd at 
the racetrack. Her Trainer encourages her, 
saying, "Let's challenge your own limits!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo said that much was easy, and 
energetically headed off to the race.
